meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Abyssal Rain
journal.description:
Nymrissa channels a torrent of water from the crevices above, inflicting 175015  Frost damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

This rain drenches its victims, inflicting 23335 Frost damage every 2 sec for 24 sec.

journal.title: Alluring Bubble
journal.description:
Nymrissa gathers water from the grotto and forms a massive bubble of swirling liquid.

The bubble entrances curious murlocs, drawing them in.

journal.title: Chilling Frost
journal.description:
Nymrissa chills players to the bone, inflicting 166681 Frost damage every 1.5 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 15% for 6 sec.

Each impact leaves behind a Frost Orb at the player's location.

journal.title: Lingering Frost
journal.description: Inflicting 100009 Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

journal.title: Pop!
journal.description: The bubble pops, unleashes a surge of pressurized water that inflicts 541714 Frost damage to all players and knocks them away.

journal.title: Swirling Whirlpools
journal.description:
Nymrissa awakens whirlpools within the grotto that surge toward the Alluring Bubble.

The whirlpools inflict 2500220 Frost damage to players in their path.

journal.title: Water Jet
journal.description:
Nymrissa condenses surrounding water into a high-pressure jet, blasting her target for 416703 Frost damage every 1 sec and gradually pushing affected players away. The surging water washes away icy patches on the ground. 

Each hit increases damage taken from Water Jet by 20% for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Pulsing Tides
journal.description: Bubblefin Berserkers pulse with the power of the deeps, inflicting 375033 Frost damage to all players every 3 sec.

journal.title: Unending Tides
journal.description: Nymrissa unleashes a catastrophic surge of water, repeatedly crashing into all players, inflicting 500044 Frost damage every 1 sec.
